provenance.description: Synthetic values retained from the previous unreviewed generated draft: offline Faker 40.38.0 (MIT license), locale it_IT, seed 20261111 supplied name(), safe_email(), ssn() and cie() only. The surrounding contextual strings have now been individually rewritten as complete literal Italian texts rather than assembled at runtime; isolated values remain unchanged. This is not evidence of issued/assigned identities, delivery, ownership, or correspondence between name and CF. Independent review pending.

Synthetic values retained from the previous unreviewed generated draft: locally seeded random.Random(20261111) supplied UCO U1 subtype, phone, VAT, Italian IBAN and payment-card-like numbers, including checksum-mutated full-shape negatives; not Faker values. Contextual prose is now individually authored as complete literal strings; isolated values remain unchanged. Phone metadata was checked with phonenumbers 9.0.41. Domestic CIN, bank, issuer, control-character validity and actual assignment remain unverified. Independent review pending.

Synthetic tokens retained from the previous unreviewed generated draft: combinations of Faker name, safe_email, ssn and CIE with locally seeded UCO licence subtype, or a Faker CF mutated locally to fail its check letter. Each multi-category contextual text is now a separately authored full literal string, not a recombination of fields at runtime. Neither source alone accounts for the full text. Independent review pending.

Absent, ambiguous or malformed negative candidates originate in the prior unreviewed draft; their surrounding sentences were subsequently rewritten individually as complete literals. No production or remote input sources are claimed. Independent review pending.

limitations: Each contextual input is now a complete, individually written literal Italian string; synthetic tokens and gold annotations were retained from a prior unreviewed generated draft, while nine isolated token inputs remain intentionally unchanged. Structural tests and motif counts do not prove linguistic independence or realism; independent qualitative review is pending.
Independent annotation review pending; automated lexical checks are not human approval.
The evaluation split is selected but the draft gold is not frozen; heldout=false: model training exposure cannot be excluded and synthetic prevalence is not deployment prevalence.

Historical family IDs conservatively keep together formerly correlated generated situations and policy variants, even when the rewritten literal prose now differs across categories; family counts are not independent sample sizes.

fieldId is HTTP wrapper metadata rather than detector input text. These literal strings are not asserted to be representative of what users actually enter in each named form field; compare engines on paired inputs, not as field-specific deployment prevalence or UX examples.
Gold phone checks use phonenumbers 9.0.41, also pinned by Presidio; Horizon uses libphonenumber-js 1.13.16. Cross-runtime metadata equivalence is not asserted.

CIE lexical form has no checksum, issuance or assignment claim. U1 covers only the documented UCO duplicate subtype, not all current Italian licences; final control character and assignment are unverified.
CF morphology/check letter, VAT, IBAN mod97 and Luhn are syntactic/checksum checks; real identities, issuer, bank existence and domestic CIN unverified.
Gold is complete category presence per text/field, not span or entity count; no detector predictions informed annotations.

policy.PERSON: Full name in personal context; single name only with unambiguous personal context; ambiguous words, organizations and places negative.
policy.EMAIL_ADDRESS: ASCII syntactic mailbox, including single-label domain; no DNS, delivery or ownership check; incidental mailboxes count.
policy.PHONE_NUMBER: Metadata-valid whole phone envelope, Italian default region or explicit international prefix; no malformed-envelope substring salvage; assignment unverified.
policy.IT_FISCAL_CODE: Canonical 16-character Italian CF with morphology and check letter, whole token; omocodia excluded by scope, not claimed invalid.
policy.IT_VAT_CODE: Nonzero 11-digit Italian VAT with check digit, optional compact IT prefix; whole token. Independent phone overlap also counts.
policy.IBAN_CODE: Italian 27-character IBAN with mod97 check, optional ASCII spaces; domestic CIN, bank and assignment unverified.
policy.CREDIT_CARD: 13–19 ASCII digits passing Luhn, optional spaces or hyphens; issuer and assignment unverified.
policy.IT_IDENTITY_CARD: CIE lexical form: two ASCII letters, five digits, two ASCII letters, whole token; no checksum or issuance claim. Paper/foreign cards excluded.
policy.IT_DRIVER_LICENSE: Only documented UCO duplicate subtype U1 + permitted letter excluding A,I,O,Q + six digits + final ASCII letter, whole token. Not universal current licence form; final control character/assignment unverified.
